name: Feathered Fate

desc4.0: When the equipper enters the battlefield or is switched in as the active character, they gain the following buff: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50. If the equipper is a <ct color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</ct> character, Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 15%, lasting 15s.
desc4.1: This buff remains active while the equipper is off-field.

story: An ancient folk song. Some claim it's been sung since the founding of Eridu, though no historical records support that claim.
